decisions.reason: The schlager compilation sits squarely in the label's core catalog and had its own page, so the firm has invested in it and can keep it in stock at little cost, which favours persisting with it.

The illustrated release series is a visible, ongoing commitment that builds the label's curated identity, so dropping it would write off substantial editorial investment and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.

The jazz vinyl reissue had dedicated presentation and fits the broadening of genres and formats the firm has announced, but a limited pressing could sell out, so the risk of it leaving the market is moderate.
The multi-disc box set required heavy production investment and is a flagship-style release, so sunk costs and reputation push the firm to keep it available even if sales are slow.
The compilation CD was only mentioned rather than showcased, so little visible commitment protects it, yet warehouse-backed catalog items usually stay listed until stock runs out.
